content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ABG Hospital Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Acharyashree Bhikshu Hospital (ABG Hospital), located in New Delhi, to fill multiple Senior Resident positions on a contract basis through a scheduled walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available in ABG Hospital Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for Senior Resident posts across different departments including Gynae, Paediatrics, and Medicine at Acharyashree Bhikshu Hospital.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for ABG Hospital Recruitment 2026 is strictly walk-in. Candidates need to download the application form from the website and report directly to the interview venue with required documents.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident positions at Acharyashree Bhikshu Hospital is officially scheduled to take place on 27 October 2026 at the designated hospital premises.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree (MD/DNB/Diploma) or equivalent in the concerned department, or alternatively have 3 years of experience working as a Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Senior Resident posts is 45 years as on the date of the interview, with permissible relaxations for reserved category applicants.

faq.question: Q7. What salary is offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per the 7th CPC pay matrix level 11, ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 along with other admissible allowances as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a filled application form, two passport-size photographs, educational certificates from matriculation onwards, medical degrees, caste certificate, residence proof, and a valid DMC registration certificate.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed or mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview for the Senior Resident positions at Acharyashree Bhikshu Hospital.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Conference Room of Acharyashree Bhikshu Hospital, located at Moti Nagar, New Delhi-110015. Candidates should report there on time.
